column22: Asst. Controller or similar
Location: Lives in Santa Ana
Compensation Requirement: Seeking $175k or better
Why Looking?: Company was sold. 325 M Life Science Manufacture.

Accomplished and results-driven Assistant Controller with 5+ years of industry experience and 13+ years of expertise in public accounting. Adept at managing complex financial functions, including financial reporting, audits, compliance with U.S. GAAP, and key accounting functions, including payroll, revenue, inventory, and fixed assets. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on driving operational efficiency, improving processes, and delivering timely, accurate financial information. Exceptional communicator with a collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams, external auditors, and senior leadership.
Skills:
Assistant Controller CPA
·         Communicate with and support Financial Planning department, executive team, and cross-functional teams to provide timely data, insights, and analysis to support decision-making.
·         Lead, develop, and mentor a team of 3-5 employees, overseeing key accounting functions including general accounting, payroll, inventory, revenue, and accounts payable.

·         Streamline and enhance the clarity, accuracy, and completeness of reconciliations and financial analyses across multiple areas, ensuring alignment with best practices and organizational goals.
·         Review and prepare complex journal entries, account reconciliations, and detailed financial analysis to ensure accuracy and compliance.
·         Oversee and prepare monthly and annual audited financial statements, ensuring compliance with accounting standards and timely delivery.
·         Lead the preparation of audit support, manage Accounting team, and collaborate with external auditors to successfully complete the annual audit process.
·         Manage the complete fixed asset function, including review, recording, and reconciliation, ensuring accuracy and adherence to company policies.
Education:
2007 Cum Laude Accounting

column22: CONTROLLER
Location: OC area (moving to the Irvine area due to growth)
Comp: $180-200's Base, Bonus, Equity
Description

The Controller will own the accounting function for a growing, commercial-stage medical device company and serve as the company’s senior accounting and financial reporting leader. This position is accountable for the integrity of the company’s financial statements, the effectiveness of its internal control environment, and the delivery of a timely, audit-ready close. The Controller will build and develop the accounting function as the company scales, set accounting policy, manage external audit and tax relationships, and act as the primary accounting liaison to the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors. The ideal candidate is a CPA with deep U.S. GAAP and manufacturing cost accounting expertise who can build scalable processes while remaining close enough to the detail to stand behind every number.
Accounting, Reporting & Compliance (Approximately 70%)
Leadership, Controls & Systems (Approximately 20%)
Planning & Business Partnership (Approximately 10%)
·         Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close; set and manage the close calendar, review all key reconciliations and journal entries, and drive continuous reduction in days-to-close.
·         Own the preparation and accuracy of U.S. GAAP-compliant financial statements, footnotes, and supporting schedules for management, the Board, investors, and lenders.

·         Own technical accounting and accounting policy, including revenue recognition, inventory, leases, stock-based compensation, and equity and debt transactions; author technical memos for significant or non-routine transactions.

·         Lead cost accounting efforts, including standard cost setting and annual revaluation, overhead absorption, inventory valuation and reserves (excess, obsolete, and expiry), physical counts, and analysis of manufacturing variances and gross margin.

·         Lead the annual external financial statement audit and any lender, investor, or diligence reviews; own the auditor relationship, timeline, PBC deliverables, and resolution of audit findings.
·         Manage the company’s tax compliance and planning with external advisors, including the income tax provision, federal and state filings, sales and use tax, property tax, and R&D tax credits.

·         Oversee treasury and cash operations, including cash forecasting, banking relationships, debt covenant compliance and reporting, and working capital management (collections, payment cycles, and inventory levels).
·         Oversee accounting for payroll, equity administration, and sales commission accruals in coordination with HR and Commercial Operations.

• Prior experience as a Controller or Assistant Controller in a medical device, life sciences, or other regulated manufacturing company strongly preferred.
• Expert knowledge of U.S. GAAP and technical accounting, with demonstrated experience writing technical memos and defending positions with external auditors.

column22: Comp: $100-110K + Bonus
Irvine area

One of the largest alternative asset managers in the world. They harness resources to bring a fresh approach, unparalleled creativity, relentless innovation, and sound Sustainability practices to the planning, development, and management of buildings everywhere. From offices, retail spaces, and logistics faciliSrties to multifamily residences, hospitality establishments, and mixed-use structures. They are reimagining real estate from the ground up.

Job Description

The Senior Accountant is responsible for completing monthly accounting, job cost management and financial reporting for selected land projects and related entities. They will be responsible to critically evaluate on-going performance, efficiency, reporting, and internal controls, Joint Venture reporting for both Operations and Finance. In addition to these duties, they will be working on cross-functional teams and collaborating with other groups.

Key Deliverables
Record and calculate sales, cost of sales, land acquisition, and accruals.
Monitor, record, and reconcile cash activity (banking, wire transfers, loan draws, capital calls, etc.).
Track property taxes and prepare payments.
Prepare entries for consolidation, elimination, sales billings, reimbursements, and month-end closing.
Reconcile accounts, including intercompany transactions and working capital.
Collaborate with internal departments on purchase orders, change orders, budgets, and reclasses.
Handle special projects (procedures, forms, templates, reconciliations).
Evaluate and implement internal controls, policies, and procedures for compliance.
Review and update process documentation regularly.
Liaise with auditors, providing requested information and responding to queries.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and year-end working papers, including balance sheet reconciliation and journal entries.
Verify accuracy of land development budgets across systems and department reports.
Prepare reports, tax filings, and general ledger account analysis.

column22: Comp: $125-150K + Bonus
Irvine area.
Commercial Real Estate Accounting Manager that reports and works closely with the principal, controller, accounting, and property management staff.
This is not a remote position.

This hands-on position is responsible for the oversight of monthly accounting and key financial statements distributed to principal, brokers, investors, tax advisors and lenders. The manager will play an active role in budgeting, forecasting and year-end audit for the operating properties.
The ideal candidate combines technical accounting expertise with a thorough understanding of leases, operating expense recoveries, and the financial drivers of commercial real estate.
Responsibilities:
Financial Reporting:
· Review and prepare property-level monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and monthly GL account reconciliations ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
· Ensure all system-prepared schedules reconcile to other system-prepared schedules and documents and resolve any reconciling differences.
· Accounts payable responsibilities for select properties in portfolio.
· Oversee cash management to ensure smooth daily operations, managing inflows and outflows of cash across all company accounts.
· Review and assist with annual Common Area Maintenance (CAM), tax, insurance, and other operating expense reconciliations.
· Produce Schedule of Real Estate Owned, Property Performance Summary, and Personal Consolidated Financials Statement.
· Maintain proficiency in accounting software for efficient financial operations.  Assist with debt re-financing, loan extensions, purchase, and exchange transactions.
· Assist in preparing loan draws including gathering and organizing all supporting documentation.
· Coordinate year-end audits and tax preparation, including schedules, documentation, and responses to external advisors.
· Any other special projects as needed.
Budget Management:
· Partners with property and asset management teams on annual budgets and forecasts, coordinating with principal’s goals and objectives.
· Reviews and assist with compliance filings.
Commercial Insurance:
· Review and assist with obtaining portfolio property insurance policies for renewal/replacement.
Audit Coordination:
· Interface, support and assist in creation of required schedules and other requirements for audits.
· Work with property managers, leasing agents, and asset management personnel.

column22: ACCOUNTING MANAGER
Location: OC
Compensation: 140 - 190k + Bonus + Excellent benefits (depending on experience DOE)
Position Summary
General Responsibilities:
Manage the accounting team, including hiring, training, performance evaluations, and professional development
Motivate, mentor, and drive a culture of continuous improvement within the team
Perform year-over-year and period-over-period variance analysis for consolidated financials, ensuring accuracy through cross-functional collaboration
Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable and receivable, general ledger, and monthly/annual closing processes
Review period-end account reconciliations and reporting packages, assisting departments in understanding financial results
Prepare and review financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements
Coordinate annual audits and prepare necessary schedules and disclosures
Develop and implement accounting policies and procedures to ensure compliance with GAAP, regulatory standards, and internal controls
Proactively research and document conclusions on accounting and compliance issues, citing relevant GAAP and internal policies
Lead special projects, including lease and fixed asset accounting initiatives, Oracle Projects enhancements, report development, and establishing new reconciliations
Requirements:
Public and private accounting experience
2-5 years of supervisory experience
Active CPA license required

column22: Salary: 115-120k + B
Location: Irvine area
ABOUT THE JOB

The FP&A Analyst will be a key contributor to the FP&A team, supporting financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analysis across the organization. This role will build and maintain financial reports, analyze performance variances, support budget and forecast processes, and partner with business units and leadership to deliver accurate, actionable financial insights.
This position will work closely with finance leadership to support executive and Board-level reporting, while helping continuously improve FP&A tools, processes, and data quality.
Duties:
<ul style=""line-height: 1.2; mso-line-height-alt: 14.399999999999999px;"">

column23: • Prepare and maintain monthly and quarterly financial reporting packages, including management and Board-level materials

• Maintain Actuals vs. Budget vs. Forecast reporting with clear variance calculations and supporting analysis.  Perform first-pass variance analysis, identifying trends, outliers, and drivers to support management review.
• Support forecast and budget processes
• Maintain and enhance planning and reporting templates across financial systems
• Support annual budget and quarterly forecast preparation and support department leaders with financial analysis and reporting.
• Support cash flow forecasting and working capital analysis, monitoring DSO, DIO, and DPO trends and other drivers across businesses
• Maintain operational and financial KPI dashboards/scorecards for BU and corporate stakeholders

• Partner in monthly budget vs. actual analysis for corporate and other centralized departments, including commentary for key variance drivers and tracking of cost savings or other business opportunities.  Work with accounting team to understand period results in order to forecast remainder of year.
• Support cost optimization and efficiency initiatives with analysis and tracking
• Prepare ad-hoc and routine reporting packages and presentations for support of Senior Executive and Board of Directors meetings
• Perform other related and assigned duties as necessary

column22: ACCOUNTING MANAGER
Location: OC
Compensation: 140 - 170s + Bonus + Excellent benefits
Position Summary
General Responsibilities:
Manage the accounting team, including hiring, training, performance evaluations, and professional development
Motivate, mentor, and drive a culture of continuous improvement within the team
Perform year-over-year and period-over-period variance analysis for consolidated financials, ensuring accuracy through cross-functional collaboration
Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable and receivable, general ledger, and monthly/annual closing processes
Review period-end account reconciliations and reporting packages, assisting departments in understanding financial results
Prepare and review financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements
Coordinate annual audits and prepare necessary schedules and disclosures
Develop and implement accounting policies and procedures to ensure compliance with GAAP, regulatory standards, and internal controls
Proactively research and document conclusions on accounting and compliance issues, citing relevant GAAP and internal policies
Lead special projects, including lease and fixed asset accounting initiatives, Oracle Projects enhancements, report development, and establishing new reconciliations
Requirements:
Public and private accounting experience
2-5 years of supervisory experience
Active CPA license required

column22: Comp: $125-150K + Bonus
Reportso the the Director
Hybrid! Mostly from home.
Location North West OC off the 405.
Cost Accounting & Product Costing
Drive annual product costing roll and costing new products, including rate development.
Ensure accurate classification of direct materials, direct labor, manufacturing overhead, period expenses, and capital expenditures in accordance with company policy and GAAP
Analyze manufacturing cost variance and drive data-driven improvements.

Own quarterly estimates for plant costs based on production plan and proactively communicate risks/opportunities and detailed variance explanations in a timely manner.

Support and assist internal department reporting requirements such as audit schedules, tax schedules, and others.
Business Partnership & Operational Support
Track and influence optimal performance (cost, fulfillment, quality, cash) and profitability within the supply chain, and company-wide.
Partner with the Production Manager to support operational decision-making and track key performance indicators to understand issues and develop solutions together.
Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Engage with teams to determine process implementation and improvements.

column22: ACCOUNTING MANAGER
Location: OC
Compensation: 140 - 170s + Bonus + Excellent benefits
Position Summary
General Responsibilities:
Manage the accounting team, including hiring, training, performance evaluations, and professional development
Motivate, mentor, and drive a culture of continuous improvement within the team
Perform year-over-year and period-over-period variance analysis for consolidated financials, ensuring accuracy through cross-functional collaboration
Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable and receivable, general ledger, and monthly/annual closing processes
Review period-end account reconciliations and reporting packages, assisting departments in understanding financial results
Prepare and review financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements
Coordinate annual audits and prepare necessary schedules and disclosures
Develop and implement accounting policies and procedures to ensure compliance with GAAP, regulatory standards, and internal controls
Proactively research and document conclusions on accounting and compliance issues, citing relevant GAAP and internal policies
Lead special projects, including lease and fixed asset accounting initiatives, Oracle Projects enhancements, report development, and establishing new reconciliations
Requirements:
Public and private accounting experience
2-5 years of supervisory experience
Active CPA license required

column22: Controller
Location:  Central OC
Compensation Target: $170-180's + B
Position Summary

Establishes, directs, coordinates, and administers a plan for the control of financial operations; provides management with financial analyses for timely and effective decision making; provides data for and/or assists in establishing major economic objectives and policies for the company; and prepares reports that outline the company's financial position in areas of income, expenses, and earnings based on past, present, and future operations. Reviews, analyzes, and interprets all financial and budgetary reports making recommendations to management; directs preparation of budgets and financial forecasts; prepares necessary schedules and reports for government agencies; coordinates audits of the company's accounts; and establishes necessary controls to safeguard the company's assets.
Essential  Responsibilities
<ul style=""line-height: 1.2; mso-line-height-alt: 14.399999999999999px;"">

column23: • Direct management and leadership of the company’s financial processes (Prepare monthly financial statements, rolling forecast, annual budget, etc.)
• Provides management with financial analyses for timely and effective decision making.
• Reviews, analyzes, and interprets all financial and budgetary reports making recommendations to management to achieve company objectives.
• Monitor and safeguard company cash.
• Partner with other members of company leadership to ensure proper return (ROI) of capital spending are established and met.
• Coordinate and lead the financial audits of the company's accounts. Establish and monitor necessary controls to safeguard the company's assets.
• Know and follow general company and corporate policies and procedures.
• Know, understand, and follow department policies and procedures.
• Provides data for and/or assists in establishing major economic objectives and policies for the company.
• Partner with other members of the organization to drive continuous improvement initiatives (daily scrum, kaizen events, RCCA, etc.)

• Meet the expectations of the position, be a leader within the site and partner with site General Manager in all aspects supporting the business, interact well co-workers, understand and follow work rules and procedures.
• Other various duties as needed or as assigned.

column22: Requirements
Education and Experience:
10 years plus in an accounting leadership role.
Accounting experience in a manufacturing environment
Prior experience in cost accounting preferred.
CPA and public accounting experience, MBA and CGMA are a plus.
Private equity experience is a plus.

column22: Finance Manager
Location:  OC or the bay area.
Compensation Target: $130-180's + B +E. (salary flex based on each company)
What they are looking for:
One opportunity could be for a strong Sr. Analyst who is ready for a Manager role & responsibility!!  5 years or more experience.
10+ years of corporate financial experience in a large, sophisticated, matrixed type company.  Big company is critical, prefer publicly traded.
Manufacturing is a big plus!
Must have FP&A experience combined with strong cost analysis experience
Cost accounting, operational analysis, KPI’s, COGS, gross margin analysis, PPV (Purchase Price Variance) analysis, etc.
FP&A to include budgeting, forecasting, annual planning, variance to plan, etc.
Must have 4-5+ years of leadership experience.

Experience should include business decision analysis, forecasting, variance analysis, annual budgeting and/or operational analysis (cost, pricing, margin, etc.), analyzing large data sets, providing ad hoc strategic analysis and the ability to “tell the story” of the analysis.
Must have strong communication skills as this position supports various business leaders across the company/high level internal customers who are non-finance people.
The “jack of all trades” experience is better than a siloed.
MBA or CMA preferred.
PROCESS IMPROVEMENT experience and accomplishments; they like to hire people who are always looking for better ways to do things.
Duties:
Lead all aspects of FP&A for the tech BU, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and monthly close reporting
Develop and maintain financial models covering product P&Ls, gross margin, R&D opex, and headcount across the switch portfolio
Analyze revenue, margin, and operating expense trends to identify opportunities to improve financial performance, investment ROI, and capital efficiency
Partner with Engineering, Product Marketing, and Operations to translate operational drivers — design wins, ramp curves, wafer and test costs, headcount plans — into financial outcomes
Prepare and present executive financial reviews covering revenue, gross margin, opex, headcount, and key business KPIs to BU and corporate leadership
Lead the annual operating plan and quarterly forecasting cycles for the BU, providing recommendations grounded in financial analysis and strategic priorities
Ensure financial integrity and alignment with corporate accounting policies, internal controls, and reporting requirements
Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives including M&A diligence, product line investment cases, long-range planning, and ROI analyses on major engineering programs
Supervise and mentor a team of FP&A professionals, building bench strength and fostering a high-performing, development-oriented culture
Stay current on semiconductor, networking, and hyperscale data center industry trends to inform forecasting assumptions and strategic decision-making

Support quarterly financial reporting for a REIT portfolio by preparing supporting schedules, completing monthly consolidation and elimination entries, reviewing property-level activity, and assisting with variance analysis

Performed detailed variance analyses comparing budgeted and actual results, communicating findings to clients and identifying key drivers of financial statement fluctuations

Led and documented in-depth client walkthroughs of key financial processes—including cost of sales, investments, payroll, and revenue—to assess operations, ensure compliance, and identify process improvements

Prepared and executed audit testing across AP, AR, cash, debt, equity, cost of sales, leases under ASC 842, revenue under ASC 606, employee benefit plans, GAAP disclosure checklists, and summary of audit differences
-Great personality and attitude!
-3 years of Big 4 experience

column22: Asst. Controller
Location: South Bay area off the 405.
Compensation: 130 - 150k + Bonus
Position Summary

The Assistant Controller is responsible for the financial planning, reporting, and analysis activities for our south bay operations. This position will be heavily relied on to be a business partner to the General Manager and Site Controller with strategic analysis and business financial modeling.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Provide timely and accurate analysis of budgets, financial reports and financial trends.

Support site functions in developing financial budgets
Provide analysis, tools and metrics that assist the Company in achieving operational and financial excellence.
Lead and support monthly performance analysis and re-forecast process.
Assist in new program contract bidding process as required to ensure required return on investment is met and appropriate margins are estimated.
Participate in Capital Expenditure Request process to ensure ROI goals are met.
Participate actively in the strategic direction and planning of the Company with President and management team.
Work directly with the C level to ensure accurate representation of financial performance.
Both lead and support with routine site audit.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or related area of study, with at least five years of related experience (preferably in the manufacturing industry).
Experience in manufacturing cost accounting, including standard costing methods.
Excellent communication skills, ability to deal with people at all levels.
Strong attention to detail and good interpersonal skills.
Strong decision making and problem solving skills.
Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced dynamic environment

Ensure financial integrity and alignment with corporate accounting policies, internal controls, and reporting requirements
Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives including M&A diligence, product line investment cases, long-range planning, and ROI analyses on major engineering programs
Supervise and mentor a team of FP&A professionals, building bench strength and fostering a high-performing, development-oriented culture

SENIOR ACCOUNTANT
Essential Functions

Prepare and analyze financial statements in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and company policies. This includes balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and other financial reports.
Lead the month-end and year-end close processes, including preparation of journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis.
Assist in the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts. Monitor budget variances and provide explanations for significant deviations.
Establish and maintain internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure the accuracy of financial data. Identify and address control weaknesses or deficiencies.
Coordinate with external auditors during annual audits and provide necessary documentation and explanations. Address audit findings and implement recommendations as needed.
Collaborate with tax professionals to ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local tax regulations. Prepare and file tax returns and assist with tax planning strategies.
Conduct financial analysis to support business decisions, such as investment opportunities, cost reduction initiatives, and pricing strategies. Provide insights into key financial metrics and trends.
Identify opportunities for process improvements in accounting procedures and systems. Implement changes to streamline workflows and increase efficiency.
Provide guidance and training to junior accounting staff on accounting principles, software tools, and best practices.
Maintaining financial reports, records, and general ledger accounts.
Perform various complex account analyses and reconciliation.
Assisting the accounting manager as needed.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Skills
Strong understanding of GAAP and financial reporting requirements.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to stay organized and problem solve in a fast-paced environment
Capable of multi-tasking and working with tight deadlines in mind
Ability to articulate issues, problem solve and analyze with creative and outside of the box thinking
Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with internal and external partners; ability to convey findings in a concise and comprehensive manner
Ability to manage a working pipeline with multiple different product types at one time
Effective organization and time management skills
Capability to build trusting relationships internally and externally and elicit confidence by demonstrating reliability
Team player with the ability to work effectively in a cooperative and diverse environment
Capacity to analyze processes, support change and think operationally and strategically to achieve business goals
Advanced use of Microsoft Office Suite
Education and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required;
Experience in public accounting strongly preferred
Active or inactive CPA license preferred, but not required
Real estate finance and related financial services industry experience a plus
Minimum of 3+ years of progressive accounting experience, including both public and private

column22: This position has been newly created because they are bringing property management/accounting “In house” (They currently outsource)
Reports to the newly hired Property Controller
They really want someone who has industrial, commercial, or retail real estate exposure.
Comp: $100-110K + bonus (10%) + fully paid medical for employee and family  -- They are very generous to employees, so nobody ever leaves : )
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Review monthly and intercompany journal entries entered by third party accounting team.
Oversee the monthly/annual closing process, assist with CAM reconciliation, job cost and provide insights to management.
Handle accounts payable weekly check run, create new vendors in MRI, handle special invoices, track parcels and tax payments.

Treasury management - Monitor and reconcile bank accounts daily, review tenant receipts (ACH, wires, lockbox, check), assist with cash forecasting, process wires, and confirm funds availability for in-house checks and wires
Collaborate with Property Managers to resolve accounts receivable issues and tenant billing. Maintain a schedule to track and book bad debt reserve.
Assist in preparing and entering annual budgets in MRI
Maintain debt and book corresponding journal entries
Communicate with management on funding requests for distributions and check runs
Ensure adherence to accounting GAAP standards and provide backup for internal/external audits.
Correspond daily with third party property accounting regarding any outstanding matters
Promote continuous process improvements, best practices, and new tools or technologies
Maintain the highest level of quality over the GL, GL sub-leger, CAM, budgets, forecasts and monthly reporting deliverables.
Master the administration of key property accounting applications, including MRI, Avid, Banking, and other key relevant technologies
Qualifications/Requirements:
Education:
Four-year college degree in accounting/finance or other related area
CPA is highly preferred
Knowledge and Experience:
The highest level of integrity & professionalism and an “ownership” mentality
5+ years of experience in property accounting and/or real estate more broadly
Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
Experience with enhancing complex systems and processes; MRI is a plus
Experience with managing teams
Demonstrated excellence in time management and ability to prioritize multiple deliverables and meet deadlines
Able to address work in a flexible way and remain open to direction from supervisors
Ability to think strategically while executing day-to-day operations effectively.

column22: The Senior Accountant provides support in the preparation of the monthly financial statements.   The primary responsibilities include but are not limited to monthly close procedures and preparation of accurate and timely reconciliations for multiple accounts as well as the analysis of financial information.
Duties & Responsibilities
Proper and timely recording of financial transactions in the general ledger
Preparing journal entries, analyses, and account reconciliations to assist with the monthly close process
Monthly bank reconciliations
Ensure the general ledger and sub-ledgers are reconciled
Organize and update financial records.
Maintaining financial reports, records, and general ledger accounts monthly
Meeting processing and reporting deadlines.
Responding to information requests, reviewing financial statements, and assisting with audits
Ensuring compliance with GAAP
Assisting the Controller as needed
Resolve accounting discrepancies and irregularities
Develop and maintain large sets of financial data with use of Excel and other tools to summarize the data to reconcile accounts
Financial audit preparation
Assist with special projects and work with Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) department with monthly reporting and ad hoc financial analysis as needed
Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree required in Accounting, Finance, Analytics, or Economics
3-10 years’ experience within a corporate enterprise a plus

column22: Sr. Analyst
Location: OC (or LA)
Compensation Target: $100-110+ 10%  (bonus are paid out)
Why is this a great opportunity:
-Rock solid company with a great reputation (never misses a bonus payout!)
-Opportunity to work with many A+ professionals and great mentors
-Plenty of room for growth and promotion!
Work with asset management, portfolio analytics and acquisition teams.
Assist with managing execution of joint-venture partnership with leading funds.
Help with portfolio and asset management including model updates and reporting.
Work alongside Asset Managers and Operations with property budgeting process and review.
Ad hoc portfolio analysis and performance scenarios to assist in management decisions.
Prepare, edit, and review portfolio Argus models.
Support quarterly budgeting by updating models, report variances and working with accounting department.
Assist the leasing team with lease abstracts.
Research potential tenants, model lease scenarios and write approval memos.
Help pull and populate comps for new industrial and office acquisitions.
Conduct market research and assist in determining and maintaining Market Lease Assumptions.
Assist the Due Diligence group and analysis of investment opportunities.
Create acquisition models, research markets and review loans.
Modeling of office and industrial types using Excel and Argus.
Preparing debt scenarios using Excel.
Investor reporting.
Assist in evaluating new industrial and office acquisition opportunities
Prepare Investment Committee Memos
Requirements:
Bachelor’s Degree required with concentration in finance/accounting/real estate preferred
2-5 years of experience in related commercial real estate role
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and Argus Enterprise experience preferred
Ability to use market research platforms

column22: Manager FP&A (may be a Sr. Mgr depending on experience DOE)
Location: North West OC.
Compensation: 150 - 165k and up DOE. + Bonus
Expectation to be able to work independently with the freedom to make decisions.
This is a Hybrid role, with the expectation of 1-2 days per week.
Reports to the CFO.
What the client is looking for:
5-10 years for experience.
MBA highly preferred but will consider without.
Must have experience in the CONSUMER PRODUCTS Manufacturing preferred.
May also consider relevant industry experience in more of a retail or distribution.
Demonstrated experience in Commercial Finance and also FP&A required.
No direct reports now but will likely have the chance to hire and build a team.
Commercial Finance:
Act as a dedicated finance partner to the Sales and Marketing teams,
Analyze the ROI of trade spend, marketing, and promotional activities.
Profitability Analysis conducting SKU-level and channel-level profitability analysis.
Evaluate gross margins, landed costs, and the impact of shipping/logistics on the bottom line.
Must have strong financial modeling using Excel.
Must be able to tell the story behind the numbers.

Why this is a good opportunity?
The chance to play a foundational role at a company concentrated on rapid growth where they can take over the market in terms of competitors and market share.
Have a seat at the table:  support the CEO, VP’s and CFO directly.  They will be looking for input and valuable insight.  This role will make a difference.
Report directly to the CFO - Fortune 100 background.  This will be a highly independent position.
The opportunity to grow with the company in terms of title and growing the Finance department.
A collaborative, international team culture where ideas and initiative are valued.
The opportunity to grow alongside Daring as they scale and shape the future of the industry.
Great leadership team.

column22: Manager FP&A (may be a Sr. Mgr depending on experience DOE)
Location: North West OC.
Compensation: 150 - 165k and up DOE. + Bonus
Expectation to be able to work independently with the freedom to make decisions.
This is a Hybrid role, with the expectation of 1-2 days per week.
Reports to the CFO.
What the client is looking for:
5-10 years for experience.
MBA highly preferred but will consider without.
Must have experience in the CONSUMER PRODUCTS Manufacturing preferred.
May also consider relevant food industry experience in more of a retail or distribution.
Demonstrated experience in Commercial Finance and also FP&A required.
No direct reports now but will likely have the chance to hire and build a team.
Commercial Finance:
Act as a dedicated finance partner to the Sales and Marketing teams,
Analyze the ROI of trade spend, marketing, and promotional activities.
Profitability Analysis conducting SKU-level and channel-level profitability analysis.
Evaluate gross margins, landed costs, and the impact of shipping/logistics on the bottom line.
Must have strong financial modeling using Excel.
Must be able to tell the story behind the numbers.

Why this is a good opportunity?
The chance to play a foundational role at a company concentrated on rapid growth where they can take over the market in terms of competitors and market share.
Have a seat at the table:  support the CEO, VP’s and CFO directly.  They will be looking for input and valuable insight.  This role will make a difference.
Report directly to the CFO - Fortune 100 background.  This will be a highly independent position.
The opportunity to grow with the company in terms of title and growing the Finance department.
A collaborative, international team culture where ideas and initiative are valued.
The opportunity to grow alongside Daring as they scale and shape the future of the industry.
Great leadership team.

column19: Comp: $130K + 10% bonus + 401k plan and a pension plan.
in office mostly – Just a few days remote days a month.
Will supervise a staff of 5.   2 Seniors in Financial reporting and 2 Staff accountants, and General Accountant

You will be responsible for month-end close reporting, including (1) accuracy and timeliness of monthly internal financial statements (2) reviewing journal entries (3) expense analysis research and (4) leading or assisting in efforts to resolve issues/discrepancies identified.
You’ll review balance sheet account reconciliations timely and thoroughly, ensuring the activity and balance align with expected results.  Investigate and resolve reconciling items timely.
Perform mentoring, coaching, training, and performance management with direct reports.  Establish and clearly communicate expectations and goals.
You will identify and implement process improvements, including (but not limited to) automation of team tasks and re-allocation of staff work to promote work balance, cross-training, and efficiency.
You will work cross-functionally with other departments to gain understanding of business and data processes.
Complete ad-hoc projects/tasks, as assigned.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance is preferred.
5+ years of professional accounting experience with an understanding of US GAAP.
ideal candidate is a seasoned Supervisor or Manager of Accounting/Reporting, who has supervised 3/4 or more.
Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.

column19: Industry: 300M international manufacturing company with 20% growth a year. Reports to the VP Finance.
What the client is looking for:
6-12+ years of corporate financial experience with managerial experience.
Must have some supervision experience.

Experience should include business decision analysis, forecasting, variance analysis, annual budgeting, and/or operational analysis (cost, pricing, margin, etc.), analyzing large data sets, providing ad hoc strategic analysis and the ability to “tell the story” of the analysis.
Must have strong communication skills as this position supports various business leaders across the company/high level internal customers who are non-finance people.
MBA or CPA a plus.
PROCESS IMPROVEMENT experience and accomplishments; they like to hire people who are always looking for better ways to do things.
Lead the FP&A function: including strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
Partner with teams to align financial strategies with business goals and drive cross-functional collaboration.
Manage and mentor a one Sr. Analyst, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional development.
Develop and maintain financial models to support strategic decision-making and long-term planning.
Provide insightful financial analysis and recommendations to senior management to drive business performance.

column19: COMMERCIAL BUSINESS LOAN ANALYST
The hiring manager is the CEO
Need minimum of 5 -10 years of business financials analysis experience
Mostly in office but may offer some hybrid flexibility
""C"" level communication is key due to the level of interaction

column20: • Work with existing and prospective clients to evaluate credit (primarily business loans) and broader banking needs and proactively work to present credit and banking solutions that fit those needs and conform to bank policy and strategic initiatives
• Structure credit products and solutions to align with business needs, perform pre-screen analysis, draft LOIs, draft credit memorandum for ultimate approval from credit and loan committees.

• Monitor existing C&I loan portfolio and serve as primary point of contact for all C&I loan customers, preform quarterly and annual reviews, review borrowing base certificates, coordinate loan draws, prepare portfolio level reports, and ensure any issues or additional credit needs are elevated to senior management as necessary.
• Preform onsite meetings and effectively communicate complex and technical credit and financial matters in a clear and concise manner with key stakeholders from existing and prospective clients.

• Continue to foster existing relationships by maintaining open communication with key points of contact, understanding their business model, needs, performance and other external factors impacting their business performance and credit needs. Proactively seek updates from customers to identify and structure additional credit solutions and propose appropriate credit structures.

• Remain well versed in market and macro-economic trends, changes to the banking, private lending, and financial institution industry, and maintain working knowledge of key regulatory requirements pertaining to lending.
• Support marketing campaigns and product launches as needed.
• Ensure accurate risk ratings for credits within assign portfolio.
• Minimum 5 years, financial planning & analysis, finance, or accounting experience

• Superior financial analysis skills including understanding and construction of income statement, balance sheet, and statement of cash flows. Well versed in various approaches to evaluating measuring an appropriate proxy for cash flow and lending specific ratio analysis
• Ability to evaluate reasonableness of borrower provided projections and any experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) a plus.

column19: This is open because another Senior Accountant is retiring next year. They want some time for knowledge transfer.
The position reports to the US Division Controller who we placed.
-Strong Cost/Inventory background (This is more important than GL side)
-5 years of experience would be ideal.
Why is this a great opportunity:
-Company growing 20% per year and very profitable (they paid out bonuses at 112% of target last year). Current revenue is $300M
-Strategic growth throughout the world. Looking at acquisitions and partnerships
-They are a leader in their space. Energy is a huge growth sector due to AI, so they are well positioned
-They just went live on Netsuite
-Their business is not impacted by tariffs
Hybrid: 3 days in office/2 from home

You will support the daily accounting and month-end closing activities including the company’s most critical accounting processes. This person should have a solid understanding of accounting in a manufacturing setting. Importantly, you will be involved in improving and simplifying our critical accounting tasks.
Prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, and monthly accruals.
Support cost accounting and inventory valuation processes; collaborate with operations to ensure accurate reporting.
Support month-end and year-end close processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Maintain the general ledger and ensure compliance with US GAAP.
Perform variance analysis and help develop financial reports.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives and system optimization.
Ad hoc requests, as needed.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance is preferred.
5+ years of professional accounting experience with an understanding of US GAAP.
Cost accounting experience in a manufacturing setting is required
Excellent analytical, communication, and organizational skills. Proficiency in Excel.
Experience with ERP systems (such as NetSuite or similar).
Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.

column19: This international manufacturing company is looking for a  senior financial leader responsible for overseeing all accounting and financial reporting functions across global operations. This role ensures compliance with both local and international accounting standards like GAAP and IFRS.
Position Type: Full Time in office in the OC area.

In this role, you will provide leadership of the company’s global accounting department and lead the development and implementation of best practices to help scale the business. You will be heavily involved in directing the future of the accounting department, including managing talent where needed and aligning key processes across the global accounting team.
This position is a critical business partner to the CFO and other managers across the company. Direct reports and total oversight of staff both US and international totaling less than 20.

column20: • Responsible for all accounting activities, specifically GL, treasury, A/P, A/R, payroll, and tax.

• Partner with FP&A to understand the results and inform where we’re going.
• Maintain a robust control environment regarding financial statements, identify gaps, recommend and implement changes.
• Set expectations, provide feedback, and hold the team accountable to a professional standard.
• Recruit, select, and train staff as needed.
• Work with outside professional advisors in the areas of audit, tax, and other matters.
• Lead projects which are aligned with the company’s annual business objectives.
• Other responsibilities as they arise due to growth.
• Professional attitude and a desire to excel.
• Energy and ability and influence the future of the department and company.
• Strong communicator. Prior experience managing people and getting the best out of the team.

column19: The Sr. Accounting Manager will play a critical role in building and leading the accounting function for a high-growth life science company!
This position will oversee all core accounting operations—general ledger, cost accounting, and financial reporting—while supporting financial planning and analysis (FP&A).
Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all financial reporting.
Perform general and cost accounting activities, including analysis of manufacturing costs, variances, and gross margin to inform pricing and operational decisions.
Maintain and reconcile the general ledger, accruals, and sub-ledgers, ensuring all transactions are properly recorded and supported.
Oversee A/R, A/P, payroll, and cash management; strengthen working capital processes including collections and payment cycles.
Prepare and review GAAP-compliant financial statements, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules for management and external reporting.
Serve as the key point of contact for the company audit, coordinating deliverables, documentation, and schedules with the company’s external auditors and internal stakeholders.
Implement and optimize accounting systems, tools, and workflows to increase automation, accuracy, and scalability.
Develop and document internal controls, accounting policies, and standard operating procedures to support audit readiness and sustainable growth.
Act as Subject Matter Expert as it relates to accounting standards, industry trends, and best practices; proactively recommend process or system improvements.
Serve as primary interface with the Audit Committee of the Company’s Board of Directors
Develop, maintain, and enhance financial models and forecasts to support decision-making and long-range planning.
Support the annual budgeting and rolling forecast processes, coordinating inputs across functions.
Conduct variance analysis and provide actionable insights to leadership on financial performance, risks, and opportunities.
Partner cross-functionally with operations, commercial, and supply chain teams to align financial results with business drivers.
The ideal candidate is a CPA with a strong foundation in U.S. GAAP, audit preparation, and process improvement who thrives in a hands-on, fast-paced environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required; active CPA license strongly preferred.
5–8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting (Big 4 or regional firm) and/or industry experience in a start-up or manufacturing environment.
Strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP, audit processes, and internal controls.
Experience with cost accounting, inventory valuation, and manufacturing variance analysis.
Excellent analytical, communication, and project management skills with a high level of attention to detail.
Self-starter comfortable operating in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment with a “builder” mindset.

column19: Sr. Pricing Analyst
The hiring manager is the CFO so this is a very visible role!
Need minimum of 5+ years of manufacturing & pricing / costing experience

Seeking a data-driven and detail-oriented approach to work closely with the Sales Team, serving as a strategic partner to develop and maintain competitive pricing strategies for our dietary supplements and wellness products.  The ideal candidate will review quotes to ensure accuracy and competitiveness for products, ensuring alignment with company policies, customer requirements, and market conditions.  This role reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer.
Analyze customer requests and specifications to ensure quotes are accurate and timely.
Ensure quotes comply with pricing guidelines, margin targets and contractual terms.
Maintain and update pricing databases, quote templates and configuration tools.
Review historical data and market trends to support pricing decisions.
Track quote performance metrics (win/loss rates, turnaround time, margin impact, post-award realized margin, etc.)
Identify opportunities to improve quoting efficiency and accuracy through automation or process enhancements.
Support RFP/RFQ responses and assist with proposal documentation when needed.
Coordinate with Operations and FP&A to standardize Labor and Overhead efficiencies on volume to expeditiously provide custom costing on a high volume of quotes.
Conduct in-depth profitability analysis for existing and new supplement products across various sales channels (retail, contract).
Monitor competitive pricing, promotional strategies and market trends to assist in identifying opportunities and threats.
Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D (Product Development), procurement, operations, FP&A and the Sales team to streamline the quoting processes and improve turnaround times.
Build, maintain and update pricing models and dashboards to support data-driven decision-making.
Evaluate the impact of pricing changes on sales volume, margin, and customer behavior.
Support promotional planning and analyzing historical performance and forecasting ROI.

Prepare regular reports and presentations including the monthly Sales Report, Profitability Analysis at Contribution Margin and the monthly Financial Results deck for senior leadership on margin, pricing performance and recommendations for improvement.
5+ years of experience in quoting, pricing analysis or sales operations.
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration.
Experience in a complex manufacturing environment is required.
Experience in a biotech or pharmaceutical industry is a plus.
Understanding of contract terms and commercial negotiations is a plus.
Proficient in complex Excel spreadsheet and database structures required.
Strong Proficiency in MS Office programs (Word, Excel, Outlook), Power BI experience is a plus.
Proficiency in written and verbal English is required.

column19: This international manufacturing company is looking for a  senior financial leader responsible for overseeing all accounting and financial reporting functions across global operations. This role ensures compliance with both local and international accounting standards like GAAP and IFRS.
Position Type: Full Time in office in the OC area.

In this role, you will provide leadership of the company’s global accounting department and lead the development and implementation of best practices to help scale the business. You will be heavily involved in directing the future of the accounting department, including managing talent where needed and aligning key processes across the global accounting team.
This position is a critical business partner to the CFO and other managers across the company. Two direct reports and total oversight of 18 staff (US & Intl).

column20: • Responsible for all accounting activities, specifically GL, treasury, A/P, A/R, payroll, and tax.
• Develop and implement best practices for the accounting team’s day-to-day and month-end activities.
• Partner with FP&A to understand the results and inform where we’re going.
• Maintain a robust control environment regarding financial statements, identify gaps, recommend and implement changes.
• Set expectations, provide feedback, and hold the team accountable to a professional standard.
• Recruit, select, and train staff as needed.
• Work with outside professional advisors in the areas of audit, tax, and other matters.
• Lead projects which are aligned with the company’s annual business objectives.
• Other responsibilities as they arise due to growth.
• Professional attitude and a desire to excel.
• Energy and ability and influence the future of the department and company.
• Strong communicator. Prior experience managing people and getting the best out of the team.
• Cost accounting experience is preferred but not required.
• Experience working in a multi-national environment required.

column19: Controller
Compensation Target: $170's to the low 190''s with bonus potential.
The Controller will lead and coordinate all aspects of operational accounting including: Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, the general ledger, cash management, payroll and tax reporting.
This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer support staff and colleagues across the US and in international locations.
The ideal candidate will be a strong communicator and motivator through business transformation and a fast-paced work environment.
Manage accounting operations including Billing, AR, AP, GL, cash management, tax reporting and payroll.
Coordinate close process in accordance with corporate accounting processes, procedures and timetables and in compliance with local, state and federal requirements.
Manage and monitor all accounts, ledgers, and reporting systems and ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial information.
Maintain the documented system of accounting policies and procedures as well as short- and long-range departmental goals and objectives.
Coordinate and prepare data and schedules for annual financial audits by independent auditors, federal and state auditors, and customer auditors.
Manage and oversee budgetary and other systems for internal control and ensuring such controls are in compliance with corporate, and regulatory policies and procedures.
Monitor and analyze monthly operating results against budget.
Ensure that all financial reports are prepared and submitted to senior management and governmental agencies as required.
Manage growing shared service center model with overseas support personnel while ensuring compliance with company policies and internal controls.
Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance.
Strong analytical skills and knowledge of GAAP.
Working knowledge of detailed financial data analysis.
Working knowledge of federal, state and local tax compliance regulations and reporting.
Strong communication, presentation, and project management skills.

column19: Commercial Property Controller

A Commercial Property Controller is a senior financial professional who oversees all accounting operations and financial reporting for a portfolio of commercial real estate properties, such as office buildings, retail centers, and industrial parks. Their primary goal is to ensure the financial health, integrity, and compliance of the properties, providing strategic financial information to support management and investor decisions.

Key responsibilities include preparing and analyzing financial statements, ensuring GAAP compliance, and explaining variances. Controllers lead budgeting and forecasting, monitor cash flow and expenses, and identify cost-saving opportunities. They oversee daily accounting functions like A/P, A/R, and general ledger maintenance, manage cash flow, and perform bank reconciliations. Controllers ensure compliance with tax and real estate laws and coordinate audits. They review leases for accurate tenant billing and perform CAM reconciliations. Responsibilities also include supporting asset management through financial reporting to stakeholders and assisting with transactions and due diligence. Controllers develop internal controls, manage financial policies, and optimize accounting software. Finally, they often supervise and mentor accounting staff.
Qualifications typically include a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, with a CPA or Master's degree often preferred.
Experience required is usually 5-10 years in accounting, with 3-5 years in a commercial real estate controller role.
The highest level of integrity & professionalism and an “ownership” mentality
8+ years of experience in property accounting and/or real estate
Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
Proven expertise in enhancing complex systems and processes
Proven expertise in managing teams

column19: Dir. FP&A
Compensation Target: $180's to the low 200's with bonus potential and perks.

This role will be highly visible within the Company and will play critical role in driving financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic analysis for the organization.  This leader will provide financial insights, support executive decision-making, and ensure alignment with business objectives to optimize financial performance.
Lead annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting process, including support and oversight of corporate departments, other centralized department budgets and business groups.
Partner with senior leadership on refinements to annual budget and quarterly forecasts/latest estimates.
Oversee and optimize value lever initiatives like working capital management and balance sheet forecasting for Company, both at corporate and business unit levels.
Guide preparation of monthly reporting to Board of Directors, including financial reporting package information, related schedules, follow up action items and executive summary information.
Responsible to lead the quarterly business review process, including providing guidance and support to business leaders and finance business partners in development and preparation of presentations.
Support and measure financial expression of long-range projections included in the strategic planning process.
Provide strategic financial insights to senior leadership, supporting key business decisions.
Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting; CPA/MBA preferred
10+ years of experience with relevant background in corporate finance
Strong working knowledge of accounting and finance operations.
Exceptional written/verbal communication skills and high attention to detail
Ability to operate in fast-paced, dynamic environment, provide constructive feedback and balance workload with multiple and competing priorities

column19: Dir. FP&A
Compensation Target: $180's to the low 200'sk with bonus potential and perks.

This role will be highly visible within the Company and will partner  the VP and CFO to play critical role in driving financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic analysis for the organization.  This leader will provide financial insights, support executive decision-making, and ensure alignment with business objectives to optimize financial performance.

Lead annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting process, including support and oversight of corporate departments, other centralized department budgets and business groups. Partner with senior leadership on refinements to annual budget and quarterly forecasts/latest estimates.
Oversee and optimize value lever initiatives like working capital management and balance sheet forecasting for Company, both at corporate and business unit levels.
Guide preparation of monthly reporting to Board of Directors, including financial reporting package information, related schedules, follow up action items and CEO executive summary information.
Responsible to lead the quarterly business review process, including providing guidance and support to business leaders and finance business partners in development and preparation of presentations.
Support and measure financial expression of long-range projections included in the strategic planning process.
Provide strategic financial insights to senior leadership, supporting key business decisions.
Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting; CPA/MBA preferred
10+ years of experience with relevant background in corporate finance
Strong working knowledge of accounting and finance operations.
Exceptional written/verbal communication skills and high attention to detail
Ability to operate in fast-paced, dynamic environment, provide constructive feedback and balance workload with multiple and competing priorities
Methodical and organized approach to completing projects.
Proven ability to build and maintain partnerships and solid working relationships with key stakeholders at all levels of the organization

column19: Cost Financial Analyst
Why Looking?: Company relocation. Public company doing business globally.
Current role is a blend of Cost Accounting & Financial Analysis
Forecasts Operational expenses, Cost of Goods Sold, Gross Margin and Capital Expenses for COGS-related departments, including facilities, manufacturing, and manufacturing engineering
Heavily involved in standard cost role, which involves BOM analysis and rolling
Accounting support: has supported month-end close, financial consolidation, journal entries, and year-end audits.
-Polished presentation and excellent communication
-BS in Business Administration (Finance) from UC 2020

Forecast Operational expenses, Cost of Goods Sold, Gross Margin and Capital Expenses for COGS-related departments, including facilities, manufacturing, and manufacturing engineering.

Lead budget vs. actuals meetings with business leaders across cross-functional teams to analyze performance and drive financial insights.

Contribute to the implementation of a new manufacturing facility, including procurement, collaborating with an external project management team, and forecasting future operations for the facility.

Create ad hoc reporting, including trend analyses, KPIs, variance commentary, forward-looking insights, and value-added financial metrics, while presenting findings to business partners.

Create journal entries for COGS allocations, E&O adjustments, and reclassifications to ensure accurate financial reporting.

Analyze and create visual decks with revenue and gross margin reports to the executive team, providing insights into financial performance and trends.

Manage headcount reporting and forecasting for assigned departments; facilities, manufacturing (Direct & indirect), manufacturing engineering, and new manufacturing facility.

Manage Capital Expense reporting and forecasting for assigned departments; facilities, manufacturing (Direct & indirect), manufacturing engineering, and new manufacturing facility.

column19: The successful candidate will be able to display excellent financial modeling and analytical skills. The successful candidate will translate data into reports and financial models supporting the management team in making informed decisions. The candidate must have the ability to logically think through an issue and create a new or enhance an existing process. The successful candidate is an innovative thinker who can be presented with a small idea or problem and turn it into actionable solution. This is a growth opportunity in a rapidly expanding company and industry.
Support quarterly forecasting and annual budgeting processes, partnering with cross-functional teams to gather inputs and ensure alignment with strategic goals
Build and maintain advanced financial models for forecasting, budgeting, scenario planning, and long-range strategic initiatives
Analyze financial results, identify key trends, and perform variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior periods
Prepare and present operational and economic models to inform strategic decisions and business planning
Develop and manage dashboards and reporting tools to deliver timely and actionable financial and operational insights

Prepare presentation materials and slides for Asset Management as part of broader monthly reporting, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and alignment with key performance indicators and strategic priorities.
Provide clear, data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to support decision-making
Contribute to business case development, special projects, and ad hoc financial analyses
Continuously improve data collection, reporting processes, and analytical workflows for greater efficiency and accuracy
Cross-train with other analysts to strengthen team agility and ensure functional coverage
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA, CFA, or advanced degree preferred
3+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, FP&A, or corporate finance
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with demonstrated expertise in financial modeling
Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with experience in data analysis and data mining
Experience with SQL and Power BI is a plus
Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
Proven ability to collaborate across functions and influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations

column19: Sr. Accountant
Why this is a good opportunity!

column20: • Work under big 6 CPA's that are great mentors!

column19: Compensation Target: $100-115k with bonus potential
Hybrid 2 or 3 days in office
Maintain accounting records in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
Assist with month end close process, including:
Preparation and posting journal entries.
Reconciliation and analysis of general ledger accounts.
Maintain accounting schedules, including Prepaids, Accrued expenses, Current/Non-current Deferrals, Intangible assets, Long-term debt and others as assigned.
Prepare and track General Journal Entries.
Assist A/P staff with coding of payables (G/L, Dept, Location).
Assist with additional duties as assigned.
Assist in maintaining fixed assets registers, including additions, disposals, and calculation of depreciation.
Assist with the development and maintenance of a capital expenditure requisition process.
Assist in the selection and implementation of a fixed asset software application.
Record any missing transactions as needed with proper supporting documentation.
Financial Reporting, Compliance, and Audits
Assist with preparation of internal financial reports.
Assist with preparing external financial reports.
Assist with other financial reporting.
Prepare schedules and documentation for various external audits and other assurance engagements.
Manage external audit and assurance engagements request lists.
Assist with design, implementation, maintenance, and monitoring of internal controls.
Perform technical accounting research and write memoranda on accounting matters.
Implement changes for new accounting pronouncements.
Actively participate in projects that will drive efficiency and streamline processes throughout the Company.
Maintain organized accounting records, including monthly analysis, reconciliations, journal entries, etc.
Minimum & Preferred Qualifications and Experience:
At least three (3) years (maybe 2 years) of work experience in accounting or auditing for a public company with a public accounting firm or U.S. public company.

column19: NO relocation or out of state candidates.

We are proud to partner with a highly respected company located in Orange County in their search for an experienced and motivated Sr. Financial Analyst to join their growing team. This company boasts exceptional leadership and culture and have been in the area for over thirty years with proven stability.

This role will join a fast-moving team of professionals and support seasoned leadership. They are eager to provide a hands-on opportunity to learn and grow within an evolving environment and work to promote their employees internally. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a team and company that is employee focused.
Well-established and respected manufacturing company in the central OC area has an immediate need for a Sr. Financial Analyst.
Company offers excellent room for professional growth as well as a highly competitive benefit package including bonus and equity.

The Opportunity
Independently prepares schedules for Senior Management presentations without the need for significant refinements. Conducts analysis, such as management of the G&A expenses, that often require exchanging information with peers outside of the FP&A function. Capable of identifying and recommending areas for process and cost improvements. Ability to communicate financial information in a clear and concise manner to non-finance/ accounting individuals. Valued as a key team member of the assigned Business Unit(s).  

What You’ll Do

column20: • Coordinates the planning and reporting process for assigned business units and serves as liaison between finance and the business for analytical and budgeting support.
• Responsible for the delivery of accurate and timely management reporting including monthly financials, revenue reporting and functional expense reporting.
• Conducts advanced analysis for middle and upper management and makes recommendations on reporting changes, entries and adjustments, pricing strategy, and/or forecasts.
• Participates in the development and coordination of the annual planning calendar, budget and forecasts.

• Proactively manages the budgeting and planning process for a plant or group of manufacturing operations including capital planning, departmental operating costs, overhead allocations and implements an appropriate review process.

• Collaborates with FP&A management to ensure accurate review and approval of annual material, labor and overhead standards. Performs Cost Accounting activities as required for areas of responsibility.
• Participates in cross-functional corporate initiatives to optimize financial systems and/or improve processes.
• Interacts with and supports both internal and external audit activities.
• Attends and actively participates in pass down meetings and interacts with individuals of all levels on the manufacturing floor.
• Provide Finance support, as needed, for periodic activities such as physical inventories, fixed asset audits, inventory excess and obsolescence, customer quotes, etc.

column19: ** Company is targeting candidates local to the Southern California area only **
Provides on-going analytical support to management including preparing budgets and forecasts, and supporting strategic planning and budgeting.

column20: • Must have strong manufacturing experience and have cost analysis/cost accounting skills– i.e. BOM’s, standards, PPV, gross margin analysis, pricing, quoting.
• Conducts monthly reporting and variance analysis in a timely manner.
• Consolidates financial results for assigned functional areas for close, forecast and budget periods.
• Supports the FP&A group in development and maintenance of financial reports.
• Provides input for continuous improvement and support of budgeting and forecasting processes.
• Track and analyze results to ensure visibility and progress towards targets. Work with business management to accelerate the achievement of strategic and financial goals.

• Provide insightful and actionable analysis of results/plans/forecasts to identify emerging trends, key risks and opportunities to improve profitability, cash flow generation and return on invested capital.

• Initiate and execute value-added analysis to drive improved decision-making, operating performance and strategy development. Examples: competitive analysis/benchmarking, working capital efficiency, industry forecasts & drivers.
• Consolidates financial results for assigned functional areas for close, forecast and budget periods.

column19: Deep technical knowledge: These firms are known for rigorous training in complex accounting standards like ASC 606 and IFRS 15, which are central to this role.
Client exposure: Alums have extensive experience working with diverse clients and complex financial situations.
Strategic perspective: Their experience exposes them to a wide range of business issues, including M&A activities.
Technical accounting requirements

Revenue recognition (ASC 606/IFRS 15): The core responsibility is ensuring proper revenue recognition from customer contracts, requiring a deep understanding of these standards. This involves a five-step model to identify the contract, performance obligations, transaction price, allocation, and recognition timing.
Contract analysis: Reviewing customer contracts for complex terms that impact how and when revenue is recognized.
Month-end close duties: Performing account reconciliations, deferred revenue calculations, and analyzing revenue trends.
M&A support: Assisting with accounting due diligence and the integration of acquired companies.
Other technical topics: As noted in the description, there is potential for expansion into other areas like equity, debt, derivatives, and financial reporting.

column19: Sr. Financial Reporting Analyst
Compensation Target: $105-120k with bonus potential (10%)

column20: • The candidate will assist in the preparation and review of financial reporting packages for both internal and external stakeholders, translate data into reports and sophisticated financial models supporting the management team in making informed decisions. This is a growth opportunity in a rapidly expanding company and industry
• Assist with the preparation and review of monthly and quarterly financial reporting packages for both internal and external stakeholders
• Analyze current and historical financial results, perform variance analysis of key metrics, identify trends and recommend actions
• Support senior management team and department leaders with in-depth analysis
• Perform various financial analysis and develop financial models to support strategic initiatives
• Develop and track key performance metrics against the company’s strategic objectives
• Actively monitor financial statement deliverables and communicate to stakeholders
• Assist in various efforts to improve the efficiency surrounding financial reporting by developing automated processes and applications
• Maintain technical knowledge by attending educational workshops and reviewing publications
• Lead monthly and quarterly presentations explaining financial results to senior management.
• Effectively collaborate with other departments such as property accounting, AP and AR
