-A strong leader who can develop a team and make changes if needed
-Strong internal controls and financial reporting background (The CFO wants someone who will “own the numbers”)
Why is this a great opportunity:
-Company growing 20% per year and very profitable (they paid out bonuses at 112% of target last year). Current revenue is $300M
-Strategic growth throughout the world. Looking at acquisitions and partnerships
-They just went live on Netsuite
-Their business is not impacted by tariff

In this role, you will provide leadership of the company’s US accounting department, lead the development and implementation of best practices, and upgrade talent. The US operation is the largest of the company’s facilities.

This position is a critical business partner to the Corporate Controller, US Plant Manager, CFO, and other managers across the company. Day one you will have three direct reports in GL, A/P, and Payroll, with the ability to add additional positions in support of the company’s growth.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
Responsible for all US accounting activities, including GL, A/P, payroll, banking, tax, and treasury.
Develop and implement best practices for the accounting team’s day-to-day and month-end activities.
Generate accurate financials. Own the numbers.
Set expectations, provide feedback, and hold the team accountable to a professional standard. Recruit, select, and train staff as needed.
Maintain a robust control environment regarding financial statements, identify gaps, recommend and implement changes.
Partner with FP&A to understand the results and inform where we’re going.
Participate in the annual financial statement audit.
Create and lead projects to automate and integrate accounting processes.
Other responsibilities that arise from time-to-time.
Proficient in NetSuite (or equivalent ERP system), including navigation, reporting, and workflow optimization. Experience with system integrations or customizations is a plus.
You thrive in a tech-enabled environment and enjoy streamlining processes through smart tools and data-driven insights.
Professional attitude and leadership presence.
Cost accounting and manufacturing experience is required.
Position is on-site at the Irvine facility.
Experience managing people and getting the best out of the team.
Desire and ability to grab the wheel and influence the future of the department.
CPA preferred but not required. Familiarity with certain technical accounting (e.g. business combinations, software capitalization, leases, commissions, standard costing) would be a plus.

Reports To: Chief Financial Officer
Industry: Supports the auto industry.

Job Summary: The Controller will oversee all aspects of financial management, including accounting, reporting, compliance and human resources. This role is crucial in ensuring the accuracy of financial records and providing strategic insights to support the company’s financial health and growth.
Monitor accounting and internal control policies and procedures to ensure accuracy and reliability of the financial transactions and records
Ensure accounting staff completes routine work and special assignments with accuracy to meet departmental and company objectives.
Manage the daily cash, check, wire and ACH collection and reconciliation process
Prepare monthly and annual financial statements in an accurate and timely manner.
Prepare quarterly budget vs actual analysis for the various departments.
Review and approve accounts payable to verify proper coding and compliance with company policy.
Review payroll and reconcile payroll deductions.
Record and review necessary journal entries monthly.
Communicate with the company’s bank representatives regarding wires, ACH’s and line of credit activity and all matters of treasury management, including loan compliance.
Assist in preparing annual budgets.
Prepare documents for annual tax returns.
Identify areas of opportunity in the department and implement required changes to improve efficiency of reporting, operational procedures and processes, or improved analysis of data.
Communicate financial information and insights to senior management. Prepare presentations and reports as needed.
Bonus % bonus based on metrics.
Annual revenue-  Just under 100 million

Reports To: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
Industry: Supports the auto industry.

Job Summary: The Controller will oversee all aspects of financial management, including accounting, reporting, compliance and human resources. This role is crucial in ensuring the accuracy of financial records and providing strategic insights to support the company’s financial health and growth.
Monitor accounting and internal control policies and procedures to ensure accuracy and reliability of the financial transactions and records
Ensure accounting staff completes routine work and special assignments with accuracy to meet departmental and company objectives.
Manage the daily cash, check, wire and ACH collection and reconciliation process
Prepare monthly and annual financial statements in an accurate and timely manner.
Prepare quarterly budget vs actual analysis for the various departments.
Review and approve accounts payable to verify proper coding and compliance with company policy.
Review payroll and reconcile payroll deductions.
Record and review necessary journal entries monthly.
Communicate with the company’s bank representatives regarding wires, ACH’s and line of credit activity and all matters of treasury management, including loan compliance.
Assist in preparing annual budgets.
Prepare documents for annual tax returns.
Identify areas of opportunity in the department and implement required changes to improve efficiency of reporting, operational procedures and processes, or improved analysis of data.
Communicate financial information and insights to senior management. Prepare presentations and reports as needed.
Bonus 5-10% bonus based on metrics.

SENIOR FINANCIAL ANALYST

The position will focus on supporting the financial analysis and modeling, budgeting process, consolidation of financial system, KPI creation, variance analysis of company performance and system implementation. Holds responsibility for maintaining compliance with GAAP accounting practices and procedures to ensure accurate and timely completion of consolidated and regional financial statements, revenue and expense recognition, reserves, and accruals. Role includes tight deadlines and a multitude of accounting activities including general ledger accounting, financial reporting, audit support annual planning activities. Works closely with the Controller on all accounting and finance matters, proposed changes to policies and procedures, to achieve best practices in accounting operations.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities
• Maintain and update financial and operational performance models and reports to understand performance and trends
• Monthly financial package consolidation for all locations and improve current model in Adaptive to include all companies

• Evaluates performance/operations/financial: reviewing and conducting complex financial analyses and variance analysis (price/volume/mix, usage variance, inflation, cost savings, cash flow, working capital)
• Prepare financial bridge for actual performance to budget/prior year
• Assist in annual budgeting process to completion of consolidation of budget file
• Track expenses and identify and investigate monthly and quarterly variances to budget and forecast while proactively identifying opportunities for improvements
• Apply Excel formulas/tools or statistical modeling to large quantities of data to deliver actionable information.
• Create and/or generate necessary reporting and analyses for business segments, brands, and products in support of strategic decision making.
• Investigate and explain variances or unexpected results.
• Assist in the analysis of financial data and extract and define relevant information.
• Continuously focus on automating and streamlining the FP&A processes
• Assist in presentation/reporting package for leadership team and corporate office
• Provide ad hoc financial models and analyses to support strategic initiatives

• Obtain and maintain a thorough understanding of the financial reporting and general ledger accounting principles and standard practices, including developing subject matter expertise for the ERP and financial reporting system. Stay current on GAAP and IFRS standards.
• Develop and maintain best practices for closing and producing quality financial statements timely and accurately.
• Collaborate with Controller and budget owners towards improved annual budget cycle.
• Partner with Controller to support overall department goals and objectives.
• Monitor and analyze department work to develop more efficient procedures and use of resources while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
• Responds to inquiries from the Controller and Leadership Team and Managers regarding financial results, special reporting requests and the like.
• Proactively provide insight and recommendations to budget managers to ensure continued alignment with the budget utilizing forecast tools.
• Work with the Controller to ensure quarterly and year-end audit deadlines are met.
• Identify continuous improvement opportunities, reduce process time and document procedures to enhance the workflow.
• Proactively monitor accounting transactions, identify large fluctuations, conduct analysis and communicate to appropriate managers.
• Support Controller with special projects and workflow process improvements.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or another related field required.
Microsoft Office ® working knowledge; advanced skills in Excel ®
Minimum five (5) years’ accounting experience at relevant level of responsibility

<div class="""" style=""font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Lucida Sans Unicode', 'Lucida Grande', 'Lucida Sans', Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; mso-line-height-alt: 14.399999999999999px; color: #393d47; line-height: 1.2;"">
Sr. Director Finance
Must have FP&A experience combined with very strong cost analysis experience from leading manufacturers.
Cost accounting/operational analysis, KPI’s, COGS, gross margin analysis, and especially PPV (Purchase Price Variance) analysis
Corporate FP&A to include budgeting, forecasting, annual planning, variance to plan, etc.
Nice to have would be strategic planning, Board presentations, interacting with the PE firm, and supporting the CFO relating to the PE needs, requests, requirements, etc.

Position Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Director of Finance to lead our financial planning and analysis (FP&A) team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cost analysis and accounting within leading manufacturing environments. This role will be instrumental in driving financial strategy, improving operational efficiencies, and providing insightful data to guide decision-making.
Oversee the corporate FP&A function, including budgeting, forecasting, and annual planning.
Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess financial performance and operational efficiency.
Conduct variance analysis to compare actual results against budgeted figures and provide actionable insights to senior management.
Deep knowledge of costing initiatives to analyze cost structures, including COGS and gross margin analysis.
Perform in-depth Purchase Price Variance (PPV) analysis to identify trends and opportunities for cost reduction.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance operational processes and optimize resource allocation.
Prepare and present financial reports to senior leadership, ensuring clarity and alignment with strategic goals.
Ensure compliance with financial regulations and internal policies, maintaining the integrity of financial reporting.
Mentor and develop finance team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.
Drive collaboration across departments to enhance financial understanding and accountability.
Partner with executive leadership to support strategic planning initiatives and assess financial implications of business decisions.
Identify and implement best practices in financial management and reporting processes.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.
7+ years of experience in FP&A and cost analysis within a manufacturing environment.
Strong analytical skills with a deep understanding of cost accounting principles, KPIs, COGS, and gross margin analysis.
Proven experience in budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Proficiency in financial modeling and forecasting tools.

Why is this a great company?:
-Great experience for VP / Controller promotion
$120-$145K + bonus (DOE) Some flex DOE

The Sr. Accounting Manager / Assistant Controller (depending on experience) will be responsible for developing, training and managing a high-performance team of accounting professionals, focused on an exceptionally smooth month-end and financial reporting processes. This person will be a player-coach, capable of managing the accounting for a highly transactional business, while taking ownership for accurate financial statement preparation and review, payroll, HR compliance, while contributing meaningfully to the development and execution of the company’s controls, financial and operational reporting and strategic finance functions
Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Ensure reports comply with GAAP and/or other regulatory standards.
Oversee the accuracy and completeness of the general ledger.
Manage journal entries and account reconciliations.
Coordinate and support closing activities.
Prepare necessary supporting documentation and adjustments.
Help maintain and improve internal controls.
Ensure compliance with company policies and external regulations.
Assist with internal and external audits.
Prepare schedules and respond to auditor inquiries.
Supervise junior accounting staff and clerks.
Provide training, mentoring, and performance feedback.
Support the budgeting process and variance analyses.
Assist in developing financial models and forecasts.
Ensure timely processing and review of payables and receivables.
Monitor cash flow and manage aging reports.
Assist in implementing or upgrading financial systems.
Identify inefficiencies and propose process enhancements.
Support strategic initiatives including M&A, financial and operational automation, and operational productivity and Lean 6σ projects.

Bachelor’s degree is required, with a strong preference for those with a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or Mathematics.  A CPA is preferred but not required and may be substituted for exceptional, practical experience.

Minimum of five years’ experience in accounting to include month end close, financial statement preparation and review, accruals, reconciliations, and controls. Experience exclusively in Public Accounting may be considered overall as well, preferably from a leading national CPA firm.
Excellent interpersonal/communication (written and verbal) skills.
Team leadership, training and management experience required.
Experience with a highly transactional company is a plus, as is experience with MS Dynamics.
Significant proficiency with or mastery of Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite.

Senior level analyst that approaches the position in a proactive manner and demonstrates intellectual curiosity towards the workflow. Departmental Operating Expense (OpEx) planning and analysis

Assists with development of insightful reporting and dashboards that are utilized by internal customers

Contributes to evolution of global Business Intelligence tools.
Perform Adhoc or project driven financial analysis to align with Global standards
Bachelor degree in finance, accounting or related field, MBA is highly desired

Strong analytical, problem solving and financial modeling
Experience in budget / forecast preparation, cash-flow, NPV, IRR and capital project management

Controller
Location: Orange County
Salary: 200-250k   + B.

This position is a critical business partner to the CFO and other managers across the company. Day One you will have two direct reports (US Site Controller and one other) and international site controllers.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
Responsible for all accounting activities, specifically GL, treasury, A/P, A/R, payroll, and tax.
Develop and implement best practices for the accounting team’s day-to-day and month-end
Generate accurate consolidated financial statements. Own the numbers.
Partner with FP&A to understand the results and inform where we’re going.
Maintain a robust control environment regarding financial statements, identify gaps, recommend and implement changes.
Set expectations, provide feedback, and hold the team accountable to a professional standard.
Recruit, select, and train staff as needed.
Work with outside professional advisors in the areas of audit, tax, and other matters.
Lead projects which are aligned with the company’s annual business objectives.
Other responsibilities that arise from time-to-time.
10+ years of progressive accounting & financial reporting experience (with some exposure to international operations/subs)
Prefer 2+ years with a Big 4 or other national public accounting firm. CPA highly preferred
Some manufacturing industry exposure (Experience in a PE owned company would be a major plus)
Cost accounting experience is required (They have another person responsible for cost/inventory accounting, but the Controller needs to have an understanding)
Need exposure to transfer pricing
Professional attitude and a desire to excel.
Energy and ability to grab the wheel and influence the future of the department and company.
Strong communicator. Prior experience managing people and getting the best out of the team.

This is an individual contributor role to start (likely will become a supervisory role)
The hiring manager is ex-Big 4, so he loves candidates with prior public accounting experience
Need minimum of 2+ years of hands-on F,P, & A experience (in some type of real estate environment) (multifamily projects, townhomes, single-family and luxury homes)
In office in the OC.
Why is this a great company?:
Large International Real Estate firm with aggressive growth plans
Strong financial leadership (ex-Big 4) and excellent mentors
Great culture and outstanding benefits!
MANAGER OF FINANCIAL PLANNING & ANALYSIS
Direct the annual budget creation, quarterly projections, and multi-year financial planning for residential properties.
Work closely with Development, Operations, and Asset Management teams to ensure financial plans align with organizational goals.
Develop and update financial models, including cash flow projections, IRR, and ROI analyses for current communities and new projects.
Perform variance analysis, comparing actual performance to budgets and forecasts, and provide actionable insights.
Oversee the preparation of monthly and quarterly financial reports, including KPI dashboards and executive summaries.
Track market trends and economic factors impacting the industry.
Collaborate with the accounting team to maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper accruals.
Support financing activities, including debt/equity deals, due diligence, and investor communications.
Identify and implement process enhancements and automation within financial planning systems and workflows.
Foster and maintain relationships with external capital partners and stakeholders.
Produce financial analyses and reports for Joint Venture partnerships.
Provide data-driven insights and scenario analyses to support investment committee decisions.
Update Pro Forma statements for sales and construction milestones.
Compile and submit Builder Profitability reports to land sellers.
Track and manage supplemental land income from builders.
Coordinate the collection of documentation for audits.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline (MBA or CPA is a plus).
5+ years of total accounting & finance experience. Prefer 2+ years of experience in a Big 4 or national CPA firm (with real estate clients)
2+ years of direct financial planning & analysis experience required
Prefer experience in residential real estate, development, or investment management.

In office west OC area.
Why is this a great company?:
Large International Real Estate firm with aggressive growth plans
Strong financial leadership and excellent mentors
Great culture and outstanding benefits!
MANAGER OF FINANCIAL PLANNING & ANALYSIS
Direct the annual budget creation, quarterly projections, and multi-year financial planning for residential properties.
Work closely with Development, Operations, and Asset Management teams to ensure financial plans align with organizational goals.
Develop and update financial models, including cash flow projections, IRR, and ROI analyses for current communities and new projects.
Perform variance analysis, comparing actual performance to budgets and forecasts, and provide actionable insights.
Oversee the preparation of monthly and quarterly financial reports, including KPI dashboards and executive summaries.
Track market trends and economic factors impacting the industry.
Collaborate with the accounting team to maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper accruals.
Support financing activities, including debt/equity deals, due diligence, and investor communications.
Identify and implement process enhancements and automation within financial planning systems and workflows.
Foster and maintain relationships with external capital partners and stakeholders.
Produce financial analyses and reports for partnerships.
Provide data-driven insights and scenario analyses to support investment committee decisions.
Update Pro Forma statements for sales and milestones.
Compile and submit Profitability reports.
Track and manage supplemental land income from guest builders.
Coordinate the collection of documentation for audits.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline (MBA or CPA is a plus).
5+ years of total accounting & finance experience. Prefer 2+ years of experience in a Big 4 or national CPA firm (with real estate clients)
2+ years of direct financial planning & analysis experience required
Prefer experience in residential real estate, development, or investment management.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling, with strong valuation skills.
Exceptional communication and presentation abilities, with a knack for simplifying complex data for leadership.
Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with a focus on innovative solutions.
Deep knowledge of real estate market dynamics and trends.
Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial statement preparation.
Enthusiasm for leveraging technology, data visualization, and process improvements.

• Ensure internal control environment in accordance with Sarbanes-Oxley requirements; Assist with Sarbanes-Oxley testing and other procedures as needed.
• Support ongoing system maintenance, upgrades and enhancements of the financial systems (general ledger and support systems) and related reporting
• Track capital project spending, timing and cost impact against project plan.

Enthusiastic, responsible, accountable, team oriented, optimistic, self-starter, …
Ability to manage others as well as “manage up”.

Controller
Location: West OC
Salary: 150k or better with a strong bonus. (The salary can be flexible depending on experience.)
OPPORTUNITY:  Reporting directly to the CEO, this role will support the team from an accounting aspect on the corporate and project side.
• Coordinate and manage the general accounting function through the entire month-end processes (closing GL, CM, AP).
• Prepare and manage the loan draw process with the Accounts Payable process
• Answer questions from other departments regarding accounting to help them complete their monthly, quarterly, and annual requirements as well as daily tasks.
• Coordinate responsibilities with the quarterly reforecast process and ensure deadlines are met.
• Coordinate responsibilities and prepare CAM reconciliations and ensure deadlines are met and payments made by tenants.
• Lead the process related to new acquisitions and dispositions within the finance and accounting aspects, which would include obtaining financing.
• Responsible for scaling internal controls and maintenance, stream-line processes within the company.
• Prepare and self-review financial packages in detail.
• Ensure timely and accurate financial information to ensure effective control of projects and sound financial decisions.
• Prepare annual corporate budget and project budgets.
• Prepare and maintain worksheets to monitor compliance with the terms of various agreements such as partnership, loan, development, and management.
• Ensure debt compliance packages are submitted timely and accurately on numerous mortgage debt obligations.
• Ensure state, federal, and property tax payments are submitted timely and accurately.
• Lead the coordination with external tax preparer.
• Initiate wires and full responsibility for all aspects of treasury management.
• Other responsibilities as it relates to accounting and finance.
Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting is strongly preferred or bachelor’s degree in Finance or Economics.
Real estate accounting experience is required.
Must have 5+ years of experience in Accounting, preferrable construction / commercial / industrial / retail accounting.
Must have experience managing at least one other person.
Highly proficient MS Excel. Working knowledge of MS Word, MS Project.
Strong written and oral communication skills are essential.
Ability to summarize complex issues and opportunities into succinct and actionable deliverables.
Hard working, motivated individual with ability to organize and balance a multi-faceted workload in an efficient manner.
A team player with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to interface with personnel at all levels.
Ability to respond and problem solve in a timely and professional manner.
Ability to manage competing deadlines and ensure timely completion.
Ability to build and maintain successful relationships with investors and clients.
Collaborate with executives/owner on business strategy to determine objectives.
Enthusiastic, responsible, accountable, team oriented, optimistic, self-starter, …
Ability to manage others as well as “manage up”.

Corporate Accountant
Industry: 100M private company. CPG
2 days in office.

Job Summary:
The ideal candidate will support day-to-day accounting operations, ensure accuracy in financial records, and contribute to the company’s financial success. Proficiency in QuickBooks and familiarity with Shopify are essential for this role.
Assist in preparing and maintaining accurate financial records using QuickBooks, including general ledger entries, reconciliations, and month-end close processes.
Process and track transactions related to sales, refunds, and expenses from our Shopify platform, ensuring seamless integration with accounting systems.
Reconcile bank statements, credit card accounts, and ecommerce payment gateways to ensure accuracy and identify discrepancies.
Support accounts payable and receivable functions, including invoice processing, vendor payments, and customer billing inquiries.
Assist in preparing financial reports, such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements, for management review.
Monitor inventory costs and assist with periodic inventory reconciliations to align with sales and purchasing data.
Help prepare budgets and forecasts by compiling data and analyzing trends in ecommerce performance metrics.
Ensure compliance with applicable tax regulations, assisting with sales tax filings and other statutory requirements.
Collaborate with the Controller and finance team to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency.
Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support audits as needed to maintain transparency and accuracy.

Location: The IE
Industry: 100M private company. Multi-location retail.

• Responsible for ensuring that accounting of the Company’s operations is in accordance with GAAP.

• Work with owners and executive leadership to ensure operational success through cost analysis support, operations support and compliance with all contractual requirements.

• Establishes accounting operational strategies by evaluating trends, establishing critical measurements, determining production, productivity, quality, and customer-service strategies, designing systems, accumulating resources, resolving problems, and implementing change.

• Provides financial projections by coordinating budget/forecast preparation, collecting, analyzing, and consolidating financial information, and advising departments on the collection and analysis of data
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field is required.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex financial information to non-financial stakeholders.

Controller

Responsible for the management of the accounting records and production of the financial reports with appropriate analysis, direct annual budget process, ensure proper internal controls to mitigate risk and compliance with GAAP.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Maximize return on financial assets by establishing financial policies, procedures, controls, and reporting systems.
• Guide financial decisions by establishing, monitoring, and enforcing policies and procedures.
• Protect assets by establishing, monitoring, and enforcing internal controls.
• Monitor and confirm financial condition by conducting audits and providing information to management.
• Prepare budgets by establishing schedules; collecting, analyzing, and consolidating financial data; recommending plans.
• Achieve budget objectives by scheduling expenditures; analyzing variances; initiating corrective actions.
• Provide status of financial condition by collecting, interpreting, and reporting financial data.
• Prepare special reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.

• Comply with federal, state, and local legal requirements by studying existing and new legislation, anticipating future legislation, enforcing adherence to requirements, filing financial reports, and advising management on needed actions.
• Maintain accounting staff by recruiting, selecting, orienting, and training employees.
• Maintain accounting staff job results by coaching, counseling, and disciplining employees; planning, monitoring, and appraising job results.
EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:
Bachelor’s Degree in accounting or finance
Minimum of 3-6 years of Controller experience in manufacturing environment.
On site in the Corona area.

Public & Private Controller  (or Asst. Controller) level candidate just entered the market.
10 years of total experience:   4 years in Big Four, 2 plus years SEC reporting in Tech, 6 years as Asst. Controller and promoted to Controller.

Location: OC area
Compensation Requirement: $145-160K base (depending on the level and schedule)

• Led the month-end close process and implemented control reviews to minimize deficiencies across accounting operations.

• Produced annual financial statements, consolidations, and elimination entries.
• Managed excise tax and B&O tax submissions, as well as HRSA reporting.
• Coordinated the transfer of 26 facilities to new operators, including managing related disposals and acquisitions.
• Performed the monthly financial close for several subsidiaries.
• Created annual financial statements, consolidation and eliminating entries.
• Managed the documentation and prepared detailed memos for several acquisition transactions.

• Led the development of the 10Q/10K/8K/Form SD filings (ie. Mineral Conflict) through Workiva. Performed detailed quarterly and annual XBRL review and worked with Workiva personnel to achieve timely filing. Managed the quarterly/year-end update of footnotes and ensured compliance with SEC filing requirements.
• Managed global ASC 606 Revenue Recognition and ASC 842 Lease Accounting implementations, assessing their impact on financial statements.
• Developed macros in Microsoft Excel/VBA to streamline ASC 606 implementation processes.
-Systems: Great Plains, UKG/Ultipro, Concur, Management Reporter, SQL, Workiva, Oracle OBIEE, Oracle FCCS

Managerial Level Talent
Public & Private Controller  (or Asst. Controller) level candidate just entered the market.
10 years of total experience:   4 years in Big Four, 2 plus years SEC reporting in Tech, 6 years as Asst. Controller and promoted to Controller.
• Led the month-end close process and implemented control reviews to minimize deficiencies across accounting operations.
• Served as the primary contact for annual audits, including city tax and bank audits, ensuring compliance and smooth audit execution.
• Supported the implementation of payroll system accounting coding.
• Managed treasury functions, including check issuance, wire transfers, and cash balance assessments.
• Oversaw legal expenses and accrual tracking, collaborating with legal to ensure accurate financial reporting.
• Calculated monthly bad debt and legal journal entries, providing timely updates to administrators and executives.
• Led the implementation of ASC 842 Leases Accounting under GAAP, utilizing Lease Query software.
• Supervised a team of 13 employees, including 5 direct reports, conducting annual reviews, and fostering professional development.
• Produced annual financial statements, consolidations, and elimination entries.
• Managed excise tax and B&O tax submissions, as well as HRSA reporting.
• Coordinated the transfer of 26 facilities to new operators, including managing related disposals and acquisitions.
• Performed the monthly financial close for several subsidiaries.
• Created annual financial statements, consolidation and eliminating entries.
• Managed the documentation and prepared detailed memos for several acquisition transactions.

• Led the development of the 10Q/10K/8K/Form SD filings (ie. Mineral Conflict) through Workiva. Performed detailed quarterly and annual XBRL review and worked with Workiva personnel to achieve timely filing. Managed the quarterly/year-end update of footnotes and ensured compliance with SEC filing requirements.
• Managed global ASC 606 Revenue Recognition and ASC 842 Lease Accounting implementations, assessing their impact on financial statements.
• Developed macros in Microsoft Excel/VBA to streamline ASC 606 implementation processes.
-Systems: Great Plains, UKG/Ultipro, Concur, Management Reporter, SQL, Workiva, Oracle OBIEE, Oracle FCCS

GREAT people to work with! Strong and stable company!

Maintains integrity of accounting information and systems, in accordance with standards and rules under GAAP, as well as other regulating bodies. Reconciles, analyzes, and synthesizes financial data from business operations. Plays an active role in preparation of public financial statements, including balance sheet, income statements, SEC filings, DOI reports and other regulatory reports. May evaluate or support the evaluation of company and regional profitability, efficiency, and product performance. May evaluate the effects of changes in accounting regulations on Company's financial statements and accounting controls. Executes accounting policy and procedures and participates in internal and external audits.

Performs complex accounting activities to maintain complete and accurate general ledger. This includes researching, as necessary, new pronouncements for reporting. Review and identify trends or issues and the related sources to make recommendations for change.
Leads special projects including process improvement initiatives.
Plays key role in monthly and quarterly close process.
Perform high level review of account balances including monthly and quarterly flux analysis.
Identify errors and risks that could have a financial impact on the company’s financial statements in accordance with company policies, US GAAP and in compliance with Sarbanes Oxley.
Communicate with multiple levels in the organization and escalate issues to appropriate management.
Prepares and analyzes monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports; ensures financial information has been recorded accurately.
Performs a variety of tasks that are highly complex with large company, multiple locations in a global environment, including different basis of accounting.
Influences department processes and procedures.
Assignments are broad and complex in nature, usually requiring significant originality and ingenuity. Has significant latitude for un-reviewed actions or decisions.
Act in an advisory capacity, making recommendations which have an important bearing on the conduct of the organization’s business.
Uses professional concepts and company policies and procedures to solve a wide range of difficult problems in imaginative and practical ways.
Unidentified errors could have a business and/or financial impact.

HOT OPPORTUNITY IN OC!!!
Dir. of Finance
Why is this a great company?:
This is a new client that is looking to build out their Accounting and Finance function.  They are a small growing events company.

The position will be a hybrid of Accounting and Finance. The position will report directly to the CEO.  They responsible for building out, structuring and formalizing the accounting function including setting up SOPs, evaluating a new accounting platform, making sure controls are in place, automating manual processes, building the accounting team as needed.  On the finance side, they will develop budgets and P&Ls for each event (including determining labor costs), create the 2 year, 3 year and 5 year strategic plan, actual vs. forecast variance and the revenue & cash flow forecasts.
This position will sit in the company’s OC office and is fully in office.
This position will be a controller role with some finance responsibilities that can eventually grow into a CFO.  In addition, this person will also coach and mentor staff.

Someone that is not afraid to “roll up their sleeves” and getting in the weeds.  They need to be flexible as things come up unexpectedly – this is not a standard 9-5 position.  They would like to hire someone that builds relationships with everyone on the team, they are cooperative, have good communications and a positive attitude.  They also want someone that likes to have fun, is comfortable in a casual work environment and is not “stuffy’.
They are looking for self-starters,  someone that likes to question how things are done…to find a better way, and prides themselves on doing a good job.
This is a small, growing company.  Current revenue’s are $13M - $14M, but they anticipate being $25M within the next 2-3 years…thus the need for hiring this position.
Bonus to be determined – the company is currently working to formalize a bonus plan as well as a 401K which should be in place by 2nd half of 2025
Medical & Dental – 90% of employees paid by company
Casual work environment – foosball, Ping-Pong, pool table, snacks, kegerator all onsite.
Not fixated on schedule – flexible work hours as long as work is getting done.
Free tickets to all the events they put on
Culture – fun, inspiring, rewarding, collaborative…they pride themselves on hiring great people and building a championship caliber team.
The company prides itself on the fact that the average employee tenure is over 6 years.
Lead comprehensive financial analysis of event performance, comparing actual results to budgets and forecasts through systems and processes with the goal of real-time reporting.
Identify trends and KPIs to guide strategic decision-making.
Analyze revenue streams and cost components to optimize profitability and efficiency.
Develop financial models and dashboards to present clear, visually appealing event financial data.
Lead and ensure accuracy with weekly and monthly reporting.

Prepare and present insightful financial reports to leadership and stakeholders on a monthly basis, within 10 days after month-end.

Budgeting and Forecasting

Audit & CPA Oversight
Accounting Policies and Procedures
Financial Risk Management
Cash Flow Management
Tax Planning and Compliance
Procurement Procedures
Contract Management and Insurance
Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable Oversight
Communication and Follow-Up
Minimum 10 years of experience in financial roles.
Proven track record in project-based budgeting and forecasting, with at least 5 years in a management role.
Thorough understanding of corporate finance, accounting principles, and compliance regulations.
Proficiency in financial management software
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with excellent organizational and leadership capabilities.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a relevant field; advanced degree or CPA preferred.

Directly coordinate with division finance leads on forecast software, modeling methodology, and assist with training new hires and new processes.
Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and create reports as needed.
Assist Divisional Finance and Corporate Accounting as needed.

Gain an in-depth understanding of homebuilding project-level budgets, operational metrics and cash flow timing. Perform analysis of historical results to implement into go forward forecast/modeling assumptions.
Build an understanding of the company accounting system and data warehousing structure, as well as how systems and data interact with company financial models.

Lead efforts to standardize forecasting and operational processes across all divisions, ensuring consistency and best practices. Train teams and oversee the implementation of newly developed financial tools and systems to enhance operational efficiency and accuracy.
Provide support for data integrity within internal reporting.
Support the greater finance and accounting teams in working to improve processes, improve cross-departmental communications, and build efficiencies within the organization.

Assist with Power BI utilization by developing and maintaining dashboards, ensuring data accuracy, and troubleshooting issues as they arise. Collaborate with teams to optimize reporting and deliver actionable insights through effective data visualization.
Oversee preparation and/or review of weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports and materials for private equity sponsors, including presentations and financial analysis.
Monitor cash flow requirements for future project acquisitions and scheduled land takedowns, providing timely insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
Continually seek to improve reports and processes.
Assist with other special projects, reports and analyses as directed by management.
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business or equivalent experience.
5 – 9 years of total experience in accounting and/or financial analysis
Prior financial modeling and complex formulas experience required. Familiarity with Workday Adaptive Planning a plus.
PowerPoint and data graphing skills preferred.
Excellent analytical skills and problem-solving abilities with great attention to details.
Understanding of accounting basics and financial statements.

Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to simplify complex financial information. Ability to make sound decisions and prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment. Pleasant, professional demeanor.

Hybrid role: 3 days in office/2 from home
Why is this a great company?:
• Well-established company in the rapid growth nutritional supplement space!
• Coordinates the planning and reporting process for assigned business units and serves as liaison between finance and the business for analytical and budgeting support.
• Responsible for the delivery of accurate and timely management reporting including monthly financials, revenue reporting and functional expense reporting.
• Conducts advanced analysis for middle and upper management and makes recommendations on reporting changes, entries and adjustments, pricing strategy, and/or forecasts.
• Participates in the development and coordination of the annual planning calendar, budget and forecasts.

• Proactively manages the budgeting and planning process for a plant or group of manufacturing operations including capital planning, departmental operating costs, overhead allocations and implements an appropriate review process.

• Collaborates with FP&A management to ensure accurate review and approval of annual material, labor and overhead standards. Performs Cost Accounting activities as required for areas of responsibility.
• Participates in cross-functional corporate initiatives to optimize financial systems and/or improve
• Works with junior financial analyst(s) and may serve as a mentor to ensure successful accomplishments of individual and team goals and objectives.
• Interacts with and supports both internal and external audit activities.
• Attends and actively participates in pass down meetings and interacts with individuals of all levels on the manufacturing floor. Establishes a regular presence on the floor.
• Provide Finance support, as needed, for periodic activities such as physical inventories, fixed asset audits, inventory excess and obsolescence, customer quotes, etc.
• Strong knowledge and understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Practices (GAAP), policies and procedures is required.
• Working knowledge of Power BI report writing capabilities is required.
• Proficient in complex Excel spreadsheet and database structures required.
• Strong organizational and analytical skills are a must.
• 5+ years of analysis, finance, or accounting experience.
• Ability to complete and draw conclusions from complex data analysis. Strong ability to apply knowledge to problem solving.
• Demonstrated success to multitask and prioritize, working in a fast paced and changing environment, meeting deadlines in an accurate and timely manner.
• Ability to connect with people – requires strong verbal and written communication skills, with ability to work effectively cross functionally with all levels.
• Able to work well under pressure while managing competing demands and tight deadlines.
• Remain engaged, proactive and positive in tough circumstances, owning assignments and taking full accountability for their success.
• Demonstrates flexibility and adaptability; thrives in a changing/fast paced environment.
• Proficient in MS Office programs (Word, Excel, Outlook), Power BI experience is a plus.
• Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field.

Accounting Manager
Location: 405 &105 Freeways
Compensation: $130-150 Base +B
• Manage the timely preparation of the monthly financial package, including correct consolidation and elimination accounting, plus a reasonable valuation of the CTA.
• Maintain month end close checklist, and communicate status with relevant team members to stay on track for a timely delivery of month end reports.
• Oversee most balance sheet reconciliations and other process controls to help ensure the reliability of the financial statements.
• Stays involved with the monthly bank rec and ensure historical data corroborates information presented on the cash flow forecast.
• Prepare and maintain an ""accounting manual"" clearly defining and documenting our internal control policies, processes, and procedures.
• Review and ensure the accurate statement of intercompany entries and foreign currency accounting.

• Review overseas payroll reports for reasonableness, inquiring where necessary on non-recurring changes for proper authorization.  Upload periodic payroll journal entries into GL, and reconcile month end accrued balance.
• Collaborate with the inventory accounting function to ensure reasonable valuation of month end inventory, COGS, and gross margins by product line.
• Supervise controls and accounting over Concur based travel & meals and ensure adequate safeguards over employee reimbursements, while ensuring timely payments.
• Troubleshoot operational accounting functions and postings from billing, cash application, and accounts payable. Work with Ops to ensure timely payment of key suppliers.
• Validate balance sheet based on periodic VAT filings.
• The successful candidate should also be capable of handling the following duties:
• Working to proactively develop new value-added reports out of the ERP for monthly package and business colleagues in other departments.
• Overseeing payroll administration support and recording using data from the outside provider.
• Partner with Operations, R&D, Engineering, and IT departments to build out our fixed asset accounting tracking, asset tagging system and procedures

Hybrid role: 3 days in office/2 from home
Why is this a great company?:
• Well-established company in the rapid growth nutritional supplement space!
• Coordinates the planning and reporting process for assigned business units and serves as liaison between finance and the business for analytical and budgeting support.
• Responsible for the delivery of accurate and timely management reporting including monthly financials, revenue reporting and functional expense reporting.
• Conducts advanced analysis for middle and upper management and makes recommendations on reporting changes, entries and adjustments, pricing strategy, and/or forecasts.
• Participates in the development and coordination of the annual planning calendar, budget and forecasts.

• Proactively manages the budgeting and planning process for a plant or group of manufacturing operations including capital planning, departmental operating costs, overhead allocations and implements an appropriate review process.

• Collaborates with FP&A management to ensure accurate review and approval of annual material, labor and overhead standards. Performs Cost Accounting activities as required for areas of responsibility.
• Participates in cross-functional corporate initiatives to optimize financial systems and/or improve
• Works with junior financial analyst(s) and may serve as a mentor to ensure successful accomplishments of individual and team goals and objectives.
• Interacts with and supports both internal and external audit activities.
• Attends and actively participates in pass down meetings and interacts with individuals of all levels on the manufacturing floor. Establishes a regular presence on the floor.
• Provide Finance support, as needed, for periodic activities such as physical inventories, fixed asset audits, inventory excess and obsolescence, customer quotes, etc.
• Strong knowledge and understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Practices (GAAP), policies and procedures is required.
• Must have strong manufacturing experience and have strong cost analysis/cost accounting skills to be considered – i.e. BOM’s, standards, PPV, gross margin analysis, pricing, quoting
• Working knowledge of Power BI report writing capabilities is required.
• Proficient in complex Excel spreadsheet and database structures required.
• Strong organizational and analytical skills are a must.
• 5+ years of analysis, finance, or accounting experience.
• Experience in a supplement or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
• Ability to complete and draw conclusions from complex data analysis. Strong ability to apply knowledge to problem solving.
• Demonstrated success to multitask and prioritize, working in a fast paced and changing environment, meeting deadlines in an accurate and timely manner.
• Ability to connect with people – requires strong verbal and written communication skills, with ability to work effectively cross functionally with all levels.
• Able to work well under pressure while managing competing demands and tight deadlines.
• Remain engaged, proactive and positive in tough circumstances, owning assignments and taking full accountability for their success.
• Demonstrates flexibility and adaptability; thrives in a changing/fast paced environment.
• Proficient in MS Office programs (Word, Excel, Outlook), Power BI experience is a plus.
• Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field.

SITE CONTROLLER
Location: Anaheim area
Compensation: $150-180k Base +B

Establishes, directs, coordinates, and administers a plan for the control of financial operations; provides management with financial analyses for timely and effective decision making; provides data for and/or assists in establishing major economic objectives and policies for the company; and prepares reports that outline the company's financial position in areas of income, expenses, and earnings based on past, present, and future operations. Reviews, analyzes, and interprets all financial and budgetary reports making recommendations to management; directs preparation of budgets and financial forecasts; prepares necessary schedules and reports for government agencies; coordinates audits of the company's accounts; and establishes necessary controls to safeguard the company's assets.
Direct management and leadership of the company’s financial processes (Prepare monthly financial statements, rolling forecast, annual budget, etc.)
Provides management with financial analyses for timely and effective decision making.
Reviews, analyzes, and interprets all financial and budgetary reports making recommendations to management to achieve company objectives.
Monitor and safeguard company cash.
Partner with other members of company leadership to ensure proper return (ROI) of capital spending are established and met.
Coordinate and lead the financial audits of the company's accounts. Establish and monitor necessary controls to safeguard the company's assets.
Know and follow general company and corporate policies and procedures.
Know, understand, and follow department policies and procedures.
Provides data for and/or assists in establishing major economic objectives and policies for the company.
Partner with other members of the organization to drive continuous improvement initiatives (daily scrum, kaizen events, RCCA, etc.)

Meet the expectations of the position, be a leader within the site and partner with site General Manager in all aspects supporting the business, interact well co-workers, understand and follow work rules and procedures.
Other various duties as needed or as assigned.
10 years plus in an accounting leadership role.
Accounting experience in a manufacturing environment (preferably in the aerospace industry).
Prior experience in cost accounting preferred.
CPA and public accounting experience, MBA and CGMA are a plus.
Private equity experience is a plus.
Ability to operate as a key member of a diversified management team.
Ability to multi-task competing demands and priorities.
View of Role as service position first.
Model personal obligation of fiduciary duty to protect shareholder investment.
Ownership of every problem detected & obligation to offer possible solutions.
Ability to coach, mentor and develop direct reports within the accounting department.
Ability to effectively articulate complex financial information to non-financial counterparts within the organization.
MS Office including Excel and Word
Experience with a Tier 1 accounting software (JD Edwards, SAP, Visual, etc.)
Financial Consolidation and Reporting Software such as Oracle HFM, Host Analytics, and Prophix.

Sr. Accountant
Location: OC Area

Compensation: $110 + 15-20% 
Industry: Real Estate
We just picked up a new search so if you know someone who has industry experience please reach out.
Must have 3 years of public accounting with some touch in real estate.
Need someone with great communication and confidence (frequent interaction with C-level)
Reports to the Corp. Controller so good opportunity for advancement!!
Need someone who takes ownership.
Very strong and stable company. They have a massive amount of equity in all their properties.
Comp: $100-110K + 15-20% bonus + FULLY PAID BENEFITS FOR EMPLOYEE AND FAMILY!
Why is this a great company?:
Highly successful real estate investment firm with $10B in assets
This position will support the Controller and have C-level exposure
Excellent benefits (Fully paid for employee and dependents!) and top of market comp
SENIOR ACCOUNTANT - This role is a blend of accounting, reporting, and budgeting/analysis

This unique opportunity performs various accounting functions for our corporate entity and reports to the Controller. This person will have the opportunity to master the accounting aspect for corporate and the properties as well as being exposed to the leasing, acquisitions and the development processes.  This is a high-exposure roll within an organization that is uniquely positioned to succeed in today’s commercial real estate environment.
Assist in drafting monthly, quarterly and annual external financial statements as well as supplementary schedules
Assist in the preparation of monthly internal reports
Master the controls and maintenance over the MRI accounting system, become a power user
Perform corporate monthly journal entries
Perform month end GL and bank reconciliations
Assist with the year-end audit and financials
Report and communicate with 3rd party lenders and vendors
Review of monthly property reports received from our 3rd party property management group
Assist in preparation of the annual corporate G&A budget
Meets the highest levels of professionalism and confidentiality of sensitive information
Work with other departments on an on-going basis to learn the business as a whole
Four-year college degree in accounting/finance or other related area
The highest level of integrity & professionalism and an “ownership” mentality
3-5 years of experience in public/private mix in accounting in private equity and/or real estate
Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
Demonstrated excellence in time management and ability to prioritize multiple deliverables and meet deadlines
Familiarity with investment fund/real estate accounting and fair value reporting preferred; exposure to MRI accounting system a plus
Demonstrated excellence in time management and the ability to prioritize multiple deliverables to meet established deadlines
Able to address work in a flexible way and remain open to direction from supervisors
MRI experience is a plus
Argus knowledge is a plus, but not required

SENIOR FINANCIAL ANALYST (SFA)
Location: Anaheim and South Irvine area
Compensation: $100-130k Base
All Hybrid
This position will be responsible for both short and long-term planning. This position will be responsible for all FP&A activities and ad-hoc projects as detailed below.
Develops, maintains, and delivers monthly and quarterly analyses, reports, and presentations ensuring the accuracy of the information, identifying key points, and develops recommendations
Performs a wide range of ad hoc analysis of financial and operational data for trends and variances and presents findings to business unit management
Work closely with accounting department to ensure accurate and consistent recording of CAPEX and expenses
Performs the consolidation of budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
Designs reports and dashboards to track key financial and operational performance metrics.
Prepares financial analysis and reporting materials for cost center owners: highlighting variances to forecast & budget,
Monitors division and department adherence to approved budget through monthly variance analysis and the provision of key explanations for business and financial results.
Participates in revenue forecasting and expense forecasting, including headcount analysis.
Participates in driving improvements to current processes, maintain KPI’s and trend analysis.
Participates and represents Finance in ERP Implementation as needed
Maintains Data Integrity of Financial Planning System including uploading financials into Host Analytics/Planful, reconciling schedules at month and quarter end. Troubleshooting any discrepancies
Cross trains peers on financial systems and processes
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or related field or equivalent combination of education/experience.
Minimum 4-10 years of relevant experience in financial planning, analysis, and accounting (including experience with revenue, margin, and spending analyses)
Experience with SAP or Oracle. Experience in Planful/Host Analytics required)
